description: Curated evidence of lava tubes at or near candidate sites. Only levels 2 and 3 are recorded here, each with a published reference. Level 1 (geological predisposition) is derived automatically from the Smithsonian GVP attributes by tools/precompute/build_dataset.py. A site absent from this file has NOT been assessed: absence is not evidence that no cave exists.

levels.3: demonstrated: a lava tube has been entered, surveyed or mapped and is documented in the cited reference
levels.2: probable: surface indicators (aligned collapse pits, skylights, sinuous collapsed channels) are reported in the cited reference, without direct survey
levels.1: predisposition only: Holocene basaltic effusive volcanism nearby (GVP); says nothing about the presence of a cave
levels.null: not assessed or no evidence either way

craters-of-the-moon.evidence: Surveyed lava tube caves in the Craters of the Moon lava field (for example Indian Tunnel), used as a planetary analog by the NASA BASALT and FINESSE programs.
references: U.S. National Park Service, Craters of the Moon National Monument and Preserve: https://www.nps.gov/crmo/
craters-of-the-moon.caveat: The site coordinate lies in the lava field; its distance to a specific tube has not been measured.

harrat-khaybar.evidence: Umm Jirsan lava tube system in the Harrat Khaybar volcanic field, entered and excavated.
references: Stewart et al. 2021, Archaeological and Anthropological Sciences 13:139, doi:10.1007/s12520-021-01365-6
harrat-khaybar.caveat: The site coordinate is approximate (data/candidates.json); its distance to Umm Jirsan has not been measured.
